company_description:
HCLTech is a global technology company, home to 230,000+ people across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services.

Our purpose is to bring together the best of technology and our people to supercharge progress. We’re supercharging progress for everyone, everywhere – our clients, partners and their stakeholders, our people, communities, and the planet.

Part of the HCL group, HCLTech was listed on the stock exchanges in India at the turn of the millennium in December 1999. Since our inception, we have pioneered several industry mainstays and established leadership positions in all our chosen segments.

As a company, we are deeply focused on accelerating our ESG agenda. We are also creating technology-enabled sustainable solutions with and for our clients and partners. We embed ESG imperatives into every aspect of our business and ensure that the progress we supercharge is responsible, inclusive and beneficial to all our stakeholders in the long term. We have committed to achieving net zero by 2040.

We recognize the impact that a business like ours can deliver in elevating communities globally, and we continue to improve our efforts and take decisive actions that benefit the communities in which we work and live. Through the HCL Foundation, the CSR arm of HCLTech, we have invested more than $130 million in social development efforts serving communities throughout India across education, health, water, sanitation and hygiene, skill development and livelihoods, environment, and disaster risk reduction, response and management.

We’re powered by our people – a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 167 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

Consolidated revenues as of 12 months ending September 2026 totaled $14.8 billion. To learn how we can supercharge progress for you, visit hcltech.com.

description: Posted date Nov. 17, 2026 Contract type Full time Job ID R-264538 Why choose AstraZeneca India? Help push the boundaries of science to deliver life-changing medicines to patients. Whether you join us in Bengaluru or Chennai, you can make a tangible impact within a global biopharmaceutical company that invests in your future. Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day. Success Profile Ready to make an impact in your career? Tech innovators Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Ownership takers If you're a self-aware self-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it. Challenge seekers Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. Proactive collaborators Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best. Responsibilities Job ID R-264538 Date posted 11/17/2026 Job Title: Senior Consultant - AI Platform Lead Location: Chennai GCL: D3 Introduction to role: Are you ready to lead an enterprise AI platform that turns trusted data and agentic systems into real outcomes for patients and the business? This is your chance to build the foundation that powers secure, reliable AI assistants and a knowledge graph used across drug discovery, development and operations. In this hands-on technical role, you will set the technical direction, own the graph and agentic platform end to end, and enable teams across the company to deliver with speed and confidence. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, security and platform partners to improve on quality, reliability and operational excellence. What could your platform unlock next quarter for scientists and decision-makers? Accountabilities: Graph Platform Ownership: Operate and evolve the knowledge graph and graph database platform to enterprise standards, ensuring performance, availability, backup/restore, access management and smooth operations; make graph and other data stores readily usable by AI agents through secure tools, accelerating insight generation. Agentic AI Orchestration: Define and implement secure agent orchestration through gateways, build and maintain MCP servers and tool layers with clear guardrails, and establish reusable patterns for prompt, skill and tool management; continuously evaluate agents with automated benchmarks to improve quality, cost and latency. Secure Access Management: Provide a consistent, secure access layer to AI tools and internal applications; maintain shared sign-in services, protect credentials and enforce authorization so users can only access what they are entitled to, reducing risk and simplifying adoption. Cloud and Kubernetes Operations: Deploy and run workloads on Kubernetes using Helm with robust ingress, secrets management, storage sizing and per-pull-request review environments; provision infrastructure as code across Azure, AWS and GCP to keep deployments portable and resilient. Data Ingestion at Scale: Build and operate reliable, resumable bulk ingestion pipelines for multi-terabyte datasets across graph, analytical and search stores; process large Parquet datasets efficiently, manage deltas and staged releases to ensure fast, trustworthy data availability. CI/CD and GitOps Enablement: Design and maintain GitHub Actions pipelines for build, test, review apps and deployment (including self-hosted runners) and run deployments using GitOps to deliver frequent, safe changes. Full-Stack Application Delivery: Build and maintain backend services in Python and frontends in React/TypeScript with strong authentication, validation, pagination and versioning; own services end to end from design through deployment, monitoring and support to create reliable developer and user experiences. Technical Leadership and Enablement: Set platform priorities and direction, review designs and pull requests, mentor engineers, and partner with data, NLP, application, security and identity teams; create architecture documents, runbooks and integration guides, and communicate designs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences to scale impact across the organization. Essential Skills/Experience: 8+ years in platform, DevOps, SRE or infrastructure engineering, including experience leading technical work or mentoring others. Working knowledge of knowledge graphs, and hands-on experience with graph databases such as Neo4J. Experience writing skills and building gateway-based agent orchestration for LLM-based assistants. Expertise in processing Parquet data at scale (with PyArrow, pandas, Polars or Spark), including partitioning, schema handling and memory-efficient loading. Full-stack development experience: Python with FastAPI for REST APIs, React with TypeScript for frontends, and the ability to maintain and upgrade existing applications and dependencies. Ability to collaborate effectively with Databricks platform and data teams, including integrating with data they produce. Strong Python and shell scripting for automation and tooling. Deep experience with Kubernetes and Helm, and hands-on experience across Azure, AWS and GCP. Good experience with CI/CD, GitHub Actions, and GitOps. Hands-on experience implementing single sign-on MSAL against Microsoft Entra ID, both frontend (React) and backend applications. Solid grounding in authentication and authorization: OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, Microsoft Entra ID and API gateway concepts. Experience running data stores in production. Infrastructure as code (Bicep, Terraform or similar) and sound secrets management. Clear written communication and good documentation habits. Desirable Skills/Experience: Hands-on experience building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or AI gateways. Experience with API gateways and proxies. Large-scale data ingestion (multi-terabyte) and database performance tuning. Observability tooling. Interest in life sciences or biomedical data. When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world. Why AstraZeneca: Here your platform craft drives real-world impact. You will help a data- and AI-led enterprise interpret complex data faster, make better decisions and ultimately deliver medicines to patients sooner. We unite powerful technologies, modern engineering and diverse expertise to solve problems that have not been tackled before, from scaling knowledge graphs to orchestrating secure agent ecosystems. You will be backed by meaningful investment, surrounded by curious builders who share openly, and encouraged to experiment through forums like hackathons and design reviews. We value kindness alongside ambition, pairing high standards with the support to learn quickly and shape how our company uses AI at scale. Call to Action: Lead the platform that turns data into decisive action for patients—take the next step today and shape what we build next! title: Perl or Python Developer
description: We are looking for an experienced Scripting & Automation Engineer to lead the modernization of legacy backend scripts, automation workflows, and data pipelines. You will combine multi-language scripting experience with prompt engineering and code review to migrate file access patterns, localize dependencies, and guarantee full functionality without network share bottlenecks. Key Responsibilities AI-Driven Path Refactoring: Direct AI tools to scan, identify, and refactor hardcoded UNC network paths, drive mappings, dynamic inclusions (use lib in Perl, sys.path in Python), and network file streams into clean, local-disk execution pathways across Perl and Python codebases. Dependency & Environment Localization: Package and isolate runtime dependencies locally—managing CPAN modules via local::lib/Carton in Perl, and Python virtual environments (venv, poetry, uv). Code Auditing & Quality Assurance: Perform line-by-line technical reviews of AI-generated code to prevent edge cases, enforce SOLID and dular design principles, resolve Windows path escape/formatting issues, and maintain high memory efficiency. Automated Testing Strategy: Build comprehensive unit and integration tests (Test::More for Perl, pytest for Python) to validate feature parity between network and local execution environments. Pipeline & Workflow Updates: Reconfigure Windows Scheduled Tasks, CI/CD pipelines, and PowerShell build scripts to execute scripts and tools natively on local disk storage. End-to-End Delivery: Take ownership of migrating legacy scripts, automation flows, and backend tasks from initial network path analysis through local verification and production rollout. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of hands-on software development and automation experience with Perl and Python in a Windows environment. Strong knowledge of Windows file systems (NTFS), network pathing mechanics (UNC format vs. local paths), process execution, and environment variables. Practical experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate code conversion, script generation, and refactoring. Deep understanding of dependency management tools across both stacks (CPAN, local::lib, Carton, pip, venv, poetry, uv). Proficient with Windows PowerShell scripting, Git version control (PR workflows, automated branch management), and CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, Jenkins). Strong analytical skills to break complex legacy applications down into precise, prompt-driven tasks for AI agents. Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year Work Location: In person
